# Parish-Level Area and Population Summary Statistics

## Load libraries
```{r}
library(terra)
library(here)
```

## Compute parish area and population
```{r}
# ---------- CRS check --------------------------------------------------
# Adm_boundaries is assumed to be loaded from 01_loading_processed_data.qmd
# Ensure CRS consistency: pop_aligned and Adm_boundaries should share the
# same projected CRS (UTM 36N).

if (!identical(crs(Adm_boundaries, proj = TRUE),
               crs(pop_aligned,    proj = TRUE))) {
  cat("Reprojecting Adm_boundaries to match pop_aligned CRS...\n")
  parish_vect <- project(Adm_boundaries, crs(pop_aligned))
} else {
  parish_vect <- Adm_boundaries
}

# ---------- Parish area (km²) ------------------------------------------
# expanse() returns area in m² for projected CRS; convert to km²
parish_area_m2  <- expanse(parish_vect, unit = "m")
parish_area_km2 <- parish_area_m2 / 1e6

# ---------- Parish population (zonal sum) --------------------------------
# If pop_aligned does not exist, align WorldPop to the travel-time grid
if (!exists("pop_aligned")) {
  cat("pop_aligned not found — aligning WorldPop to base_tt_all grid...\n")
  pop_dir  <- here("Data", "processed", "Worldpop_density")
  pop_file <- list.files(pop_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  pop_file <- pop_file[grepl("pop_total", pop_file, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(pop_file) == 0) pop_file <- list.files(pop_dir, "\\.tif$",
                                                     full.names = TRUE)[1]
  pop_rast_tmp <- rast(pop_file)
  pop_aligned  <- project(pop_rast_tmp, base_tt_all, method = "bilinear")
  pop_aligned  <- mask(pop_aligned, base_tt_all)
  rm(pop_rast_tmp)
}

# Zonal sum of population per parish
parish_pop <- terra::extract(pop_aligned, parish_vect, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---------- Build parish-level data frame --------------------------------
parish_df <- data.frame(
  Parish     = parish_vect$PName2016,
  Area_km2   = round(parish_area_km2, 3),
  Population = round(parish_pop[, 2])
)

cat("\n=== Parish-level summary ===\n")
print(parish_df, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Summary statistics
```{r}
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("  Parish Area (km²)\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("  Mean   :", round(mean(parish_df$Area_km2),   3), "\n")
cat("  Median :", round(median(parish_df$Area_km2), 3), "\n")
cat("  IQR    :", round(IQR(parish_df$Area_km2),    3), "\n")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("  Parish Population\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("  Mean   :", format(round(mean(parish_df$Population)),   big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  Median :", format(round(median(parish_df$Population)), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  IQR    :", format(round(IQR(parish_df$Population)),    big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```
